user.title: mqttview
user.description:
The address of your mqttview, as your browser reaches it. The panel is an iframe, so this is fetched by the browser and not by Home Assistant — localhost would mean the phone.

mqttview refuses to be framed by default. Set frame_ancestors in its configuration to this Home Assistant's origin, or the panel will be blank.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full http:// or https:// address, for example https://mqttview.example.com

abort.already_configured: The mqttview panel is already set up.
